verdict.rationale: AvaTax is an API-first service. It documents REST v2 endpoints such as CreateTransaction and CreateNexus, official SDKs in six languages, an official MCP server, and a 90-day free trial with API/SDK access for testing, so it runs headlessly from scripts and pipelines by design. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance or a CLI, documented non-interactive auth and sandbox credentials for pipelines, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
